verdict.rationale: HumanLayer can create structured tasks from GitHub, Linear and Jira issues, and it offers a PRD-Oriented workflow option that could frame scope before implementation. Nothing documents ingesting user feedback submissions specifically, or generating a proposed scope from them, so support is glancing. Missing for 10: feedback-submission intake, automatic proposed-scope generation from feedback, how the PRD-Oriented workflow produces scope, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope

citations.quote: Connect Linear so HumanLayer can create tasks from Linear issues, sync issue status, and link HumanLayer artifacts back to the source issue.
Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.
